name: TerrainStroke
doc: A complete gesture, retained as source rather than destructive tile snapshots.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: Gesture ordering within a layer; stable ID breaks concurrent ties.

fields.name: dabs
fields.doc: Brush samples in gesture order (at most 4096).

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: Paint channel, from zero to three.

fields.name: stamp
fields.doc: Immutable stamp payload hash; absent for other operations.

fields.name: sourceTile
fields.doc: Destination grid tile for an import layer; absent for brush operations.
